project.name: Prince Edu Hub - Google Business Profile & Growth Engine
project.description: Multi-location Google Business Profile management, reputation automation, daily WhatsApp growth digests, campus review targets, and embeddable live chat for Prince Edu Hub educational institutions in Sikar, Rajasthan.

nodes.name: GoogleBusinessController.php
nodes.summary: Primary backend controller managing Google OAuth2 lifecycle, location discovery, review fetching and filtering, Gemini AI response drafting, and review reply publishing.

nodes.name: AuthController.php
nodes.summary: Manages panel staff authentication, session cookie validation, campus wing assignments, and rate-limited credential checks.

nodes.name: ChatAgentController.php
nodes.summary: Handles campus counselor chat inbox operations, conversation lifecycle, message dispatch, and internal private staff notes.

nodes.name: ChatWidgetController.php
nodes.summary: Public endpoint serving embeddable website widget initialization, live SSE streaming, and visitor inquiry dispatching.

nodes.name: FacebookPageController.php
nodes.summary: Integrates Meta Graph API v21 for Facebook page status checks, post extraction, and AI rewrite into Google Business posts.

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Master SPA container hosting the top app bar, collapsible workspace navigation hubs, review audit lists, and Google Sheets sync.

nodes.name: DailyWhatsAppReport.tsx
nodes.summary: Morning executive review growth cockpit: displays campus leaderboards, today vs historical comparisons, in-charge phone tags, and simulated WhatsApp chat preview.

nodes.name: DailyReviewTargetPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Dedicated target planner view with auto-distribution algorithms across 7 days, progress meters, and printable audit reports.

nodes.name: GrowthTools.tsx
nodes.summary: Generates printable QR review stand artwork for campus reception desks and sends pre-composed WhatsApp review invitations.

nodes.name: WebsiteWidget.tsx
nodes.summary: Configures and previews embeddable website badges and review carousels showing live Google verified ratings.

nodes.name: ChatManager.tsx
nodes.summary: Coordinates live support tabs: counselor inbox, visual drag-and-drop auto-reply flow builder, canned responses, and analytics.

nodes.name: FlowBuilder.tsx
nodes.summary: Visual node-based canvas for authoring automated interactive conversation trees with simulated live phone preview.

nodes.name: profileIsolation.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side tenant isolation logic: enforces campus wing boundaries ensuring staff only interact with assigned locations.

nodes.name: reviewTeam.ts
nodes.summary: Official staff registry mapping campus locations to responsible coordinators, WhatsApp phone numbers, and wing assignments.

nodes.name: dateUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Guarantees Indian Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata) date boundaries for accurate daily review calculations and cut-offs.

edges.description: Fetches locations, reviews, posts, and publishes AI replies
Authenticates user session and validates permissions
Renders WhatsApp growth tab and preview
Renders QR stand generator and growth toolkit
Hosts website live chat and chatbot builder
Filters visible campus tabs by authenticated user wing
Looks up in-charge name and phone for each campus
Excludes unauthorized campus profiles for members
Integrates interactive visual bot flow builder canvas
Syncs counselor messages and conversation statuses
Saves and publishes live bot flow trees

layers.name: Backend Controllers & Services
layers.description: Laravel 12 API controllers, OAuth authentication, Google My Business API integration, and SSE message streaming.

layers.name: Frontend Cockpit & UI Suite
layers.description: React 19 single-page dashboard with Tailwind CSS v4 styling, review feeds, and growth tools.

layers.name: Domain Rules & Roster Utilities
layers.description: Campus tenant isolation guards, IST date utilities, and staff coordinator contact directories.

tour.title: Welcome & Google Business Profile Sync
tour.description: Everything begins at App.tsx and GoogleBusinessController.php, where OAuth2 connects to Google to discover campus locations and fetch live reviews.

tour.title: Daily WhatsApp Growth & In-Charge Leaderboard
tour.description: DailyWhatsAppReport.tsx aggregates today's reviews across all campuses (PCP, Prince School, Prince College, NDA, Hospital) against baseline counts.

tour.title: AI Review Automation via Gemini Flash
tour.description: GoogleBusinessController.php utilizes Google Gemini 2.5 Flash to automatically craft high-quality, polite review responses tailored to each campus tone.

tour.title: Website Reviews Widget & Counselor Live Chat
tour.description: WebsiteWidget.tsx and ChatManager.tsx deliver real-time social proof and live two-way student counselor messaging to institutional websites.

tour.title: Tenant Security & Campus Wing Isolation
tour.description: profileIsolation.ts and AuthController.php ensure coordinators strictly see reviews and posts belonging to their assigned campus wing.
